label: Sort Records
description: Sort records by one or more fields.

english.default: Sort records by {{#each (sortKeys param)}}{{#if @first}}{{tableColumn sourceFile sourceAlias fieldName}} in {{default direction "Ascending"}} order{{else}}, then by {{tableColumn sourceFile sourceAlias fieldName sameSource}} in {{direction}} order{{/if}}{{/each}}.

default.excel: =SORTBY({{firstKeyTable (sortKeys param) param.source_file param.source_alias}}, {{#each (sortKeys param) separator=", "}}{{firstKeyTable (sortKeys param) param.source_file param.source_alias}}[{{excelColumn (default fieldName (placeholder "field" "[field]"))}}], {{#if (eq direction "Descending")}}-1{{else}}1{{/if}}{{/each}})
default.sql: ORDER BY {{#each (sortKeys param) separator=", "}}{{field sourceFile fieldName alias=sourceAlias}} {{#if (eq direction "Descending")}}DESC{{else}}ASC{{/if}}{{/each}}
default.python: df = df.sort_values([{{#each (sortKeys param) separator=", "}}{{quote fieldName}}{{/each}}], ascending=[{{#each (sortKeys param) separator=", "}}{{#if (eq direction "Descending")}}False{{else}}True{{/if}}{{/each}}], kind="stable")
